home.heroText: Hoteli ifite ubusitani ku muhanda Huye–Tumba. Ibyumba bituje, amafunguro meza n'umwanya wo guhurira hamwe.
home.introText: Arboretum Green Hotel ni hoteli y'ubusitani iri ku muhanda Huye–Tumba. Tugendera ku muvuduko utuje: mu gitondo hatuje, amafunguro meza, ibyumba bigufasha gusinzira.

doors.stay: Ubwoko bune bw'ibyumba, byose bituje kandi byitaweho.
doors.dine: Resitora, akabari n'aho banywera ikawa, kuva mu gitondo kugeza nijoro.
doors.discover: Ishyamba rya Ruhande, Kibeho Ubutaka Butagatifu, Nyungwe ku munsi umwe.

home.eveningText: Ifunguro rya nimugoroba munsi y'igisenge cy'imbaho, icyo kunywa ku kabari, ikawa ya nyuma kuri terasi.
home.contactText: Twandikire kuri WhatsApp cyangwa uduhamagare. Usubizwa n'umuntu wo ku iyakira, si imashini.

stay.title: Ibyumba byo kuruhukiramo.
stay.text: Ubwoko bune bw'ibyumba, byose bifite ubwiherero bwite, amashuka asukuye buri munsi n'amajoro atuje.

dine.title: Amafunguro meza, kuva mu gitondo kugeza nijoro.
dine.text: Ahantu hatatu munsi y'igisenge kimwe: resitora yo kurya utuje, akabari ka nimugoroba, n'aho banywera ikawa mu gitondo.
dine.kitchenText: Byose bivuye mu gikoni twakwishimira kukwereka. Tubwire ibyo udashobora kurya cyangwa ibyo ukunda igihe ufata umwanya.

meet.title: Umwanya wo guhurira hamwe.
meet.text: Inama, ubukwe, ibirori byo kurangiza amashuri n'iby'umuryango, byakirwa twitonze nk'uko twakira umushyitsi umwe.
meet.quoteText: Tubwire itariki, umubare w'abashyitsi n'ibyo ukeneye. Tuzakoherereza igiciro mu munsi umwe w'akazi.

discover.title: Ongeraho umunsi umwe.
discover.text: Huye ni umujyi wa kaminuza mu Rwanda n'umutima w'umuco. Aha ni ahantu abashyitsi bacu babaza kenshi.
discover.nameText: Imigano iruhande rwa terasi, ibimera kuri buri muryango, ubwatsi munsi y'amatara. Ubusitani ni bwo buduha ituze tubaha.

contact.title: Fata umwanya & twandikire.
contact.text: Uburyo bwihuse bwo kutugeraho ni WhatsApp. Ushobora kuduhamagara igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.
contact.formText: Ku cyumba, ibirori cyangwa gufungura. Tugusubiza kuri telefoni cyangwa imeli.
contact.name: Amazina yombi
contact.sent: Murakoze. Ubusabe bwanyu bwageze ku iyakira, turabasubiza vuba.
contact.failed: Ntibyashobotse kohereza ubu. Twandikire kuri WhatsApp cyangwa uduhamagare.
contact.required: Andika amazina yawe na nimero ya telefoni.

footer.preview: Urubuga rw'igerageza. Amakuru afite akadomo munsi aracyategereje kwemezwa.

privacySections: Arboretum Green Hotel, Umuhanda Huye–Tumba, Huye, Rwanda, ni yo ishinzwe amakuru bwite akusanyirizwa kuri uru rubuga. Twandikire: arboretumgreenhotel@gmail.com cyangwa +250 781 600 065.
Ayo mwihitiyemo kutwoherereza gusa: amazina, telefoni, imeli, amatariki, umubare w'abashyitsi n'ubutumwa iyo mukoresheje ifishi, n'ibyo mwandikira iyakira kuri WhatsApp.
Gusubiza ubusabe bwanyu, kwemeza no gukurikirana icyumba, ameza cyangwa ibirori byanyu, no kubika inyandiko itegeko risaba. Ntitugurisha amakuru yanyu kandi ntituyakoresha mu kwamamaza.

Mudasobwa cyangwa telefoni yanyu ibika iminsi 30 akamenyetso gato kerekana uko mwatubonye (urugero Google cyangwa Instagram). Kongera nimero ngufi nka AG-G-7K2Q ku butumwa bwanyu kugira ngo tumenye inzira ikora. Nta kintu kibaranga kirimo.
Tubara abasura urubuga dukoresheje uburyo bwubahiriza ibanga, butagira cookies kandi butabika amakuru bwite.
WhatsApp (Meta) itwara ubutumwa bwa WhatsApp; serivisi y'imeli itugezaho ubusabe bw'ifishi; ikarita iri ku ipaji ya Twandikire itangwa na Google, ishobora gushyiraho cookies zayo iyo muyikoresheje.

Hakurikijwe itegeko ry'u Rwanda rirengera amakuru bwite n'ubuzima bwite (Itegeko N° 058/2021), mushobora gusaba kureba, gukosora cyangwa gusiba amakuru yanyu, cyangwa kwanga ko akoreshwa. Mutwandikire kuri imeli iri haruguru, tuzabasubiza mu minsi 30.
termsSections: Ibiciro bigaragazwa mu mafaranga y'u Rwanda kandi bishobora gutangwa mu madolari. Igiciro mwemerewe mu nyandiko ku cyumba cyanyu ni cyo gikurikizwa.
Kwishyura 50% mbere byemeza icyumba cyanyu. Twakira MTN MoMo, Visa, Mastercard, amafaranga mu ntoki no kohereza kuri banki.
Mushobora guhagarika ku buntu kugeza amasaha 2 mbere y'igihe muteganya kugera. Nyuma yaho, avansi ishobora kudasubizwa.
Gusohoka ni mbere ya saa yine (10:00). Isaha yo kwinjira yemezwa hamwe n'icyumba cyanyu.
Gufata ibirori, menu n'ikodeshwa ry'icyumba cy'inama byemezwa mu nyandiko y'igiciro yihariye.
Tugerageza ko amakuru ari kuri uru rubuga aba ari ukuri, ariko menu n'amasaha bishobora guhinduka. Mwemeze ibikomeye n'iyakira.
